verdicts.why: Landman and Zack is a law firm named on screen. Daredevil S1 episode 10 shows Matt and Foggy as interns there until they quit over the Roxxon case and open Nelson & Murdock. HANDOFF keeps past groups (that is why the backstory removals were reverted), and Foggy's file keeps the same stage. One caveat: the service is shown only in flashback (S1 ep 10, plus Born Again S2 ep 5).

Agent Carter S1 episode 7 ('SNAFU') shows him in 1943 as a medical officer in a Soviet army camp. He survives Finow and in 1944 is taken into Leviathan, which is a real move. 'Soviet Armed Forces' with Agent Carter S1 is already the dataset's form (Brannis, Demidov), and HANDOFF keeps past groups.
The stage is keyed to the whole show, but the record uses seasons. She serves Leviathan in season 1 (Fennhoff's plot) and is a freelance thief in season 2, so the stage belongs at 'Agent Carter S1'.

In S2 episode 22 ('S.O.S. Part Two') Ward takes charge of the HYDRA thugs ('I'm done flying solo... I want more names' / 'Hail Hydra to that') and sets out to rebuild HYDRA. Season 3 only shows him already running it, so the stage belongs at S2.

In Madame Web Ben is Cassie's paramedic partner, an FDNY EMT, and works that job on screen when he revives her. Marvel Database lists the New York City Fire Department for both Ben and Cassie (Earth-688B), and 'FDNY' is an existing dataset name.

This file is on record in season 6. In S6 'Toldja', Izel buys Fitz and Simmons on Kitson and makes them part of her crew. They turn on her in 'Collision Course Part Two' and rejoin S.H.I.E.L.D. The twin A:st-leo-fitz already has both stages.

Eyes of Wakanda episode 2: B'Kai serves undercover as 'Memnon' in the Greek army under Achilles, the Myrmidons' commander. Ferro, a Myrmidon, doubts his loyalty, and the name is said on screen. He turns on them and returns the pendant to Wakanda. Undercover service counts (Simmons inside HYDRA, then S.H.I.E.L.D., is the same pattern).

After Namor destroys the Raft, Zemo escapes in the life pod with the heroes. He travels with them to New Asgard and dies there. The dataset's 'The Survivors' covers both the Raft survivors and the heroes, so he never leaves it, and death is not a departure. The wiki lists the survivor groups as his affiliation, not marked 'formerly'.

FATWS episode 1: with the Avengers disbanded, Sam works for the U.S. Air Force as a contractor on repeated missions under Major Hill, with Lt. Torres as his support. The Air Force is named on screen, and this is ongoing work, not a one-job hire. At the end of Brave New World he decides to rebuild the Avengers, so they stay his last stage. Caveat: in Thunderbolts* the team is still 'being assembled', so the owner may prefer the minimal version (only the FATWS Air Force stage).

Ironheart episode 4: Madeline owns and runs her Chicago shop. Ronnie brings Riri to her there, and she ushers them out. The shop is named on screen ('Welcome to Stanton's. We got sweets. We got reads.'), and the MCU wiki gives its full name. She does not end with no group.
This goes with item 3009. She runs Stanton's in Ironheart, so a 'left' meaning no group afterwards does not hold.

value: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
verdicts.why: Both stages are right. Xialing employs Jon Jon as ringmaster of her fight club, and in the post-credits scene he stands at her side as she takes the Ten Rings throne. But the dataset spells the club 'The Golden Daggers Club' (A:xialing), not 'Golden Daggers Club'.

Her stages already put her last departure in Iron Fist S1: in episode 13 she decides to leave, leaves New York and joins Davos in Paris. In S2 she only signs her buyout and partners with Davos, who is an ally, not a group. So no departure happens in S2 and that 'left' is a leftover.

Mike starts as a Centipede test subject. In S1 'The Bridge' he trains as a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent with Coulson's team, and afterwards he is forced to serve Centipede and HYDRA as Deathlok before walking away in the finale. That gives the twin's order (Centipede, S.H.I.E.L.D., HYDRA, Independent), and the villain file lacks the S.H.I.E.L.D. stage.
